description: This file defines the RelatedProduct class, which extends Product and implements Serializable. It includes a field for relationship type and basic getter/setter methods.

classes.name: RelatedProduct
classes.description: A class representing a related product, extending Product with an additional relationship type attribute.

methods.name: setRelationShipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship for this related product.

methods.name: getRelationShipType
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship type for this related product.
